question: Can non-residents get a mortgage in Dubai?
answer: Yes, several UAE banks offer mortgages to non-resident buyers, though loan-to-value ratios are generally lower than for UAE residents (financing for non-residents is typically capped around 50–60% of the property value, versus up to 75–80% for UAE residents, depending on the bank and whether it's a first property). Terms vary by bank and change over time, so we recommend comparing current offers or speaking with a mortgage advisor before budgeting.
